$comment: GENERATED - DO NOT EDIT. Source: registry/root.jsonld

externalCodeList.ddiEmission: concept[@vocab='<vocab>'] in place of inline catgry; catgry MUST NOT be emitted
externalCodeList.limesurveyEmission: base select (L/M) with the vocabulary's options inlined as A/SQ rows + cssclass='cdlvocab-<vocab>' carrying provenance (a registered LimeSurvey question attribute, so it survives import)
externalCodeList.structuralNote: select_multiple_from_file emits a flat <var> with concept/@vocab, NOT a varGrp[@type='multipleResp'] with binary children. This differs from select_multiple.
externalCodeList.vocabularyDeclaration: Vocabularies are open-ended: this convention defines only how one is declared and handled, never which ones exist. To add one, put its options in registry/vocab/<name>.csv with a 'code,label' header and add a '@type': 'Vocabulary' node to the graph with xlsformFilename/ddiVocab/vocabURI/standard/skos:prefLabel. Every consumer discovers vocabularies by filtering '@type' == 'Vocabulary', so no code, convention or emitter needs editing. vocab:iso_3166_1 is one example, not a special case.

xlsformLanguageList.fallback: first language encountered in label columns
xlsformLanguageList.note: Each language code SHOULD be a valid IETF BCP 47 tag (e.g. 'de', 'en', 'fr-BE'). Tools may warn on non-BCP47 codes.

lsTsvHandling.emission: one row per language per question — same name/type, different language column + text/help cells
lsTsvHandling.baseLanguage: first emitted; subsequent languages reference same question name

ddiHandling.emission: one child element per language with xml:lang attr

logicMapping.description: XLSForm expresses survey logic in an XPath subset; LimeSurvey uses ExpressionScript (EM). The transformation transpiles between them (implemented in src/pipelines/xlsform2lstsv/xpathTranspiler.ts). DDI Codebook has no machine-readable expression syntax — logic fields are dropped when emitting DDI and tools MUST report this as loss.

ddi.note: DDI universe describes the subpopulation as prose, not as machine syntax. Currently NOT emitted — relevance is dropped in DDI output.

fields.xlsformSyntax: XPath subset, `.` refers to the answer

ddi.note: DDI valrng can express simple numeric ranges only. Currently NOT emitted — constraints are dropped in DDI output.

syntaxMappings.ls: {name} in labels; name / name.NAOK in expressions
syntaxMappings.note: Variable reference; name is sanitized per convention:sanitization.
select_multiple expands to per-choice binary subquestions, so membership becomes a check on the choice column.

logicMapping.unsupportedFunctionBehavior: error — the transpiler throws on any XPath function outside supportedXPathFunctions

fields.ddiPath: codeBook/@version (DDI version, not survey version — record survey version elsewhere)

magicNames.note: Body text from label promoted to survey-level intro. Convention only; opt-in via tool config.

unregisteredRows.metadataBehavior: skip silently — device/session metadata rows carry no authored content
unregisteredRows.unknownTypeBehavior: error — the registry is an allowlist; any survey-sheet type that is neither registered nor a metadata row MUST abort the transformation with a clear message

xlsformColumnMap.transform: XPath → LimeSurvey EM expression — see convention:logicMapping
XPath → LimeSurvey EM expression — see convention:logicMapping

composites.label: Grid / Matrix Group

trigger.xlsformPattern: begin_group row with appearance=table-list (or name contains 'grid', or label contains 'matrix')
trigger.applyTo: begin_group + all rows until matching end_group

rows.match: type=select_one <listname> — all items MUST share the same listname

ddi.memberVars: one <var> per item row. Each var carries the full <catgry> set repeated (responseDomainType='category').

lsTsv.headerRow: F-type question (matrix header) with answerClass=A; answer codes from shared list
lsTsv.note: LS represents the matrix as a single question with sub-questions; categories not re-emitted per row

notes: If `appearance=table-list` is absent, the group is flattened — children become top-level vars in DDI, group is lost.
Items SHOULD share the same `listname` so the matrix is rectangular.
